date.as_written: śrī nepālasamvata ritu rasā nava varṣa saṃjña māghase ca śucīpache pañcamyā ca titho pauṣṇe ca nāma nakṣutre śubhe ca yoga maṃgalavārasano ... śrīkalījuge bhoga 4942 śrīśakrarājasya śakakāla 1796 śrīsamvata 1898 sāla miti māghaśukrayā paṃñcami reotinakṣetra śūbhayoge aṃgavārasare ca

notes: No individuals (scribe, patron, or king) are named in the colophon. The date is given in four eras: Nepal Saṃvat ('ritu rasā nava', chronogram for 966 or possibly corrupt for 962), Kaliyuga 4942, Śaka 1796 (likely error for 1763), and Vikrama Saṃvat 1898, all pointing to Māgha śukla 5 (Śrīpañcamī), Tuesday, matching early 1842 CE.
